candidates.why_relevant: Financial-news and FX property operated by Roklen Holding a.s. (Prague), part of a group that also contains RoklenFx and Roklen Corporate Finance. Sections: Novinky, Menove pary (EUR/USD, EUR/CZK, USD/CZK, GBP/CZK), FX pruvodce, Ekonomicky kalendar. Relevant to this cell chiefly on the payments/FX-conditions edge - e.g. cross-border and e-commerce currency-conversion practice, where non-bank FX providers publish comparisons that expose bank FX margins that banks themselves never state as a headline number. Editorial mix observed skewed to FX and macro rather than retail bank fees, and its ownership by an FX provider is a direct competitive interest in how bank FX pricing is portrayed.
candidates.source_subtype: financial news portal owned by an FX/corporate-finance group
candidates.access_status: open, no paywall observed; active as of the fetch
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; owner is a commercial competitor to bank FX services - flag the conflict of interest on every extracted claim about bank pricing
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency monitoring of the Novinky stream filtered for bank FX and payment-conversion topics. Always record the Roklen ownership alongside any comparative claim about bank FX pricing.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles inference (who benefits from revealing bank FX margins); direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: Czech news site tagged 'ekonomika, politika, byznys a finance', managed by Copywrite Company s.r.o., with sections spanning economics, politics, EU affairs, finance, business, investments, plus a podcasts/interviews section. Despite the fintech-suggestive name the observed coverage was general economic and political news (US debt, digital currencies, Czech pensions, pharma competition, Ukraine) rather than Czech retail-bank product or fee detail. Recorded here for completeness of the cell's media map and because its podcast/interview strand may carry Czech financial-sector executives, but yield for this cell's specific topics is unproven and looks thin.
candidates.source_subtype: general economics/business news site with a finance desk
candidates.access_status: open, no paywall evident; no RSS or newsletter link surfaced on the homepage
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; all content marked as protected by the operator
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not build a dedicated collector. Spot-check the podcast/interview section quarterly for Czech banking executives; otherwise deprioritise.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-domain inference from the 'fintech' stem; direct fetch, which downgraded the initial assumption

candidates.why_relevant: Internet Info group's Czech internet/technology title ('server o ceskem Internetu'), sister to Mesec.cz and Podnikatel.cz. Included at low priority as a possible route to Czech digital-identity, e-government and online-service stories that touch bank identity services (BankID) and digital channels. HOWEVER the homepage fetch showed no dedicated banking, payments or fintech coverage - the technology focus was connectivity, AI, quantum, cloud, 3D printing, cybersecurity, startups, e-government and TV/streaming (DigiZone). Treat the banking yield as unproven and low.
candidates.source_subtype: technology/internet news title (same publisher family as Mesec.cz)
candidates.access_status: open; no RSS link visible on the homepage, though the publisher family exposes /rss/ paths on Mesec.cz so probe the same pattern
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted editorial content; same publisher family as Mesec.cz
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-filtered monitoring only ('BankID', 'bankovni identita', 'platby', 'banka'), monthly at most. Do not allocate a dedicated collector until a keyword probe demonstrates yield.
candidates.discovered_via_method: publisher-family snowball from Mesec.cz; direct fetch, which downgraded the initial expectation

negative_findings.description: The WebSearch tool was unavailable for this entire cell: the very first search call returned 'this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)'. Not one of the six seed queries, in Czech or English, could be executed, and no query-driven discovery or result-page snowballing (including the instructed 'look past the first page of results') was possible.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero WebSearch queries executed. All 23 candidates were found by direct WebFetch of hypothesised URLs derived from the seed cell text, from Czech-language term-and-domain construction (e.g. 'bankovni poplatky' -> bankovnipoplatky.com, 'sazebniky' -> kurzy.cz/banky/sazebniky/), from first-principles source-category inference, and from on-page snowballing through fetched navigation, publisher families and branding.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage of this cell is biased toward outlets discoverable by name or by predictable Czech URL construction. Smaller regional outlets, newsletters, Substack-style independents, YouTube/podcast-first banking commentators and any outlet whose name could not be guessed are systematically under-represented. The cell should be re-run once search budget is restored; the seed queries remain unused and are still worth executing verbatim.

negative_findings.description: Penize.cz - explicitly named in the coverage cell - could not be inspected. HTTP 403 Forbidden with no response body on both https://www.penize.cz/ and https://www.penize.cz/bezne-ucty. Its sister title https://finmag.penize.cz/ returned an identical 403.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three fetches across two hostnames on the same publisher infrastructure, all 403. Consistent with an edge WAF or bot filter, not with a dead or moved site (a dead host would refuse the connection; a moved one would 404).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the two anchor portals in this cell is undocumented. Its comparison tables, fee coverage and company-data sections are unmapped, so any completeness claim for the Czech consumer-finance comparison layer is currently false. Per the run's hard rules this is a hypothesis of bot defence, NOT a liveness verdict.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to verify the 'Zlaty mesec' award, which the Czech consumer-finance press associates with Mesec.cz, at https://www.zlatymesec.cz/. The connection was refused outright: ECONNREFUSED 195.250.144.110:443.
negative_findings.result_summary: No HTTP response at all - the host resolved to 195.250.144.110 but refused the TLS connection. Distinct from the 403 and 404 patterns seen elsewhere in this run. The award may have been folded into mesec.cz itself, retired, or the site may serve on HTTP only or be temporarily down.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the award still runs it is a second longitudinal Czech bank-ranking panel alongside Banka roku and Zlata koruna. It should be re-probed (http:// as well as https://, and a site-scoped search of mesec.cz) before being written off - a single refused connection is not proof the award is dead.

negative_findings.description: Investujeme.cz's dedicated banking section at https://www.investujeme.cz/bankovnictvi/ rendered a single article dated 2022-09-20, about banking and insurance recruitment and salary levels, with no product, fee, ATM-network or executive coverage.
negative_findings.result_summary: The banking taxonomy node is either abandoned or the live banking coverage has moved to a path not discoverable without search. Homepage-level banking and mortgage coverage does appear current.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pointed at /bankovnictvi/ would silently return nothing for years and look like a healthy but quiet feed. The active path must be re-mapped before this source is wired up.

negative_findings.description: Mesec.cz's own homepage navigation advertised a section path '/bankovni-ucty/', but https://www.mesec.cz/bankovni-ucty/ returned HTTP 404 Not Found. The working structure is https://www.mesec.cz/produkty/ with children /produkty/osobni-ucty/, /produkty/podnikatelske-ucty/, /produkty/sporici-ucty/, /produkty/kreditni-karty-pro-obcany/, /produkty/charge-karty/, /produkty/terminovane-vklady/, /produkty/stavebni-sporeni/.
negative_findings.result_summary: Nav-label-derived paths are unreliable on this site; the /produkty/ hub is authoritative and was verified to render a live fee comparison table.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Records a concrete URL-construction trap for the highest-value source in this cell, so the collector build does not lose time to it and does not misread the 404 as the source being dead.

negative_findings.description: Kurzy.cz banking verticals (/banky/, /banky/sazebniky/, /bankomaty/) returned only the site header, publisher identification (Kurzy.cz, spol. s r.o. and AliaWeb, spol. s r.o.), navigation, and a user-authentication message. No section body was returned on any of the three fetches. No 404 and no 403 was raised.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three fetches, three empty bodies with HTTP success. Hypothesis: client-side rendering, or a registration gate, or aggressive markup stripping in conversion - not a dead section.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A potential fourth independent normalisation of Czech bank sazebnik and ATM data is unassessed. If it renders under a headless browser it is a valuable cross-check; if it is login-gated it should be dropped in favour of the banks' own sazebnik PDFs. It must not be recorded as dead.

negative_findings.description: Two outlets whose names implied strong fit turned out to under-deliver on this cell's topics on inspection. FinTag.cz, despite the fintech-suggestive name, published general economics and politics (US debt, Ukraine, pharma) rather than Czech retail-bank product or fee detail. Lupa.cz, the Internet Info technology title, showed no dedicated banking, payments or fintech coverage on its homepage at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are recorded as low-priority candidates with the shortfall documented rather than dropped, so a future run does not re-discover them and re-inflate expectations from the name alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasted collector capacity and stops name-based optimism from inflating the apparent density of the Czech specialist-media layer.

negative_findings.description: Local-language (cs) coverage was achieved despite the search outage: every candidate but none-excepted was fetched at a Czech-language property, and Czech domain terms were used constructively to locate sources - 'bankovni poplatky' produced bankovnipoplatky.com/.cz, 'sazebniky' and 'bankomaty' produced the Kurzy.cz vertical paths, 'banky' produced banky.cz, and 'poradci sobe' produced the adviser community. The Czech glossary actually exercised includes: sazebnik, poplatky, vedeni uctu, vyber z bankomatu, vyber na prepazce, osobni/bezny ucet, podnikatelsky ucet, sporici ucet, terminovany vklad, stavebni sporeni, kreditni/charge karta, hypoteka, RPSN, urokova sazba, repo sazba CNB, bezkontaktni platba, platebni terminal, bankovni identita/BankID, zebricky, srovnani, rozhovory, personalie, regulace, predplatne.
negative_findings.result_summary: No topic in this cell had to be pursued in English only. English-language search was, however, not performed at all because of the budget outage, so the en-language half of the mandate is unfulfilled.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Satisfies the mandatory local-language requirement on the cs side and records exactly which Czech terms proved productive, so the re-run can start from a working glossary. It also flags honestly that the en-language leg is missing, not merely thin.

coverage_gaps.description: No keyword search of any kind was possible (WebSearch budget exhausted at the first call), so the six assigned seed queries were never run and no result-page snowballing occurred. Discovery relied entirely on URL hypothesis, first-principles category inference and on-page navigation snowballing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run this cell with search budget available and execute the six seed queries verbatim in Czech, plus extensions such as 'zmena sazebniku 2026 banka', 'rusi pobocky banka CR', 'sit bankomatu CR zmeny', 'srovnani poplatku bezny ucet', 'ceska banka rozhovor generalni reditel technologie'. Compare the resulting source set against this slice to measure the discovery bias introduced by the outage.

coverage_gaps.description: The English-language leg of the mandate is entirely unfulfilled. No en-language query was run, so English-language coverage of the Czech banking market - the trade press that writes about CEE banking in English, and English-language editions or summaries produced by Czech outlets - was not assessed at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run English queries on restoration: 'Czech Republic retail banking fees comparison portal', 'Czech banking trade magazine interview CEO digital', 'CEE banking trade press Czech banks fees ATM network', and check whether any of the confirmed Czech outlets (bankovnictvionline.cz, cc.cz) publish an English edition or English newsletter.

coverage_gaps.description: No Czech banking or personal-finance PODCAST, YouTube channel or newsletter-first publication was identified. Executive interviews about technology and payment strategy - exactly what the cell rationale calls out - increasingly appear in audio/video formats and in email-first products rather than on indexable article pages. Poradci-sobe.cz and profipf.cz were observed to carry podcast/video strands, and bankovnictvionline.cz has an app, but no standalone audio/video source was mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search Czech podcast directories and YouTube for banking and fintech shows; check whether Bankovnictvi, CzechCrunch and Poradci-sobe podcast strands have their own feeds (RSS/Apple/Spotify) that can be transcribed and monitored independently of the article layer.

coverage_gaps.description: Branch-closure and ATM-network-change coverage is the weakest verified strand in this cell relative to how central the cell rationale makes it. bankovnipoplatky.cz's section listing mentions branch closures, and Mesec.cz's tables carry per-bank ATM withdrawal charges, but no source was found that systematically tracks Czech ATM COUNTS or branch counts over time. The Kurzy.cz /bankomaty/ vertical, which might do exactly this, did not render.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the Kurzy.cz /bankomaty/ rendering question with a headless browser; separately look for a dedicated Czech ATM-locator or ATM-network dataset, and for coverage of the shared-ATM operators, which would be the actor to track for network consolidation.

coverage_gaps.description: The two highest-value institution-facing trade titles in this cell are subscription-gated: Bankovnictvi (bankovnictvionline.cz) shows preview excerpts with full text behind 'CELY CLANEK'/Predplatne, and PROFI Poradenstvi & Finance gates its magazine. FOND SHOP is likewise paywalled. The executive interviews that motivate this cell are therefore only partially readable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for legitimate subscriptions to Bankovnictvi (offers a free sample issue to evaluate first) and to PROFI Poradenstvi & Finance. Do not attempt paywall circumvention. Meanwhile capture headline, dek, interviewee name, employer and role from the free index pages - that metadata alone supports an executive-and-topic tracking table.

coverage_gaps.description: RSS/feed availability was confirmed for exactly one source in this cell (Mesec.cz at https://www.mesec.cz/rss/clanky/, valid RSS 2.0, excerpt-only items). Every other candidate's feed status is unknown - most homepages advertise only email newsletters, and no /rss/ probing was done beyond Mesec.cz.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Systematically probe /rss/, /rss/clanky/, /feed/ and /feed.xml on every confirmed domain in this slice, and parse each homepage's <link rel=alternate type=application/rss+xml> tags. Feed-based collection is far cheaper and far more robust than HTML scraping and would change the collection-method recommendation for most of these sources.

coverage_gaps.description: No Czech-language source dedicated to the MERCHANT/acquiring side of payments - payment terminals, card acceptance pricing, POS technology - was found as a specialist outlet. Podnikatel.cz is the closest proxy and covers it only incidentally; SystemOnLine covers bank-side IT rather than merchant acceptance. Given this run's payments scope, the acceptance layer is materially under-covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search for Czech retail/e-commerce trade media and acquiring-vendor publications ('platebni terminal', 'akceptace karet', 'akceptacni sit', 'QR platba', 'obchodnik prijem karet'), and check whether Czech e-commerce and retail trade titles carry a payments desk.

coverage_gaps.description: Publisher/operator identity is unresolved for two candidates that would otherwise rate higher: bankovnipoplatky.cz (no imprint surfaced on the pages fetched, despite it being the most on-topic fee watchdog in the cell) and fintechcowboys.cz (ownership not disclosed). Credibility scores for both are capped by this rather than by anything observed about their content.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the imprint/kontakt/o-nas pages and cross-check the operating entity in the Czech commercial register (justice.cz / ARES) before either source is weighted in analysis. Ownership matters especially for a fee watchdog, where a hidden commercial sponsor would invert the interpretation of its findings.

brief: The Czech specialist retail-finance media layer is dense, mature and unusually machine-friendly: Mesec.cz is the anchor, publishing a dated, sortable per-bank fee table (~30+ current accounts, with monthly maintenance 0-490 Kc, own/partner ATM withdrawal and counter-withdrawal lines, stamped 'updated 1. 7. 2026') alongside a confirmed RSS feed, with Finparada.cz, Finance.cz and Banky.cz providing three further independent normalisations of the same underlying sazebniky - which is what makes cross-checking, and therefore change detection, viable. The professional tier is real but gated: Bankovnictvi (bankovnictvionline.cz, publisher 4H production s.r.o.) is actively running named executive interviews (KBC, Komercni banka, CSOB, CNB, EY) plus /technologie, /regulace and a /personalie appointments feed behind a subscription, and is complemented on the distribution side by PROFI Poradenstvi & Finance and the Poradci-sobe.cz adviser community, and on the vendor side by IT Systems' 'Banky a financni organizace' vertical. Award and catalogue properties - Zlata koruna (700+ products, results 2009-2025) and Banka roku (24 editions) - offer ready-made longitudinal panels of Czech bank product posture that are entirely external to bank self-disclosure. Two hard caveats on this slice: WebSearch was exhausted before a single seed query could run, so discovery was by URL hypothesis and snowballing only and is biased toward guessable names; and Penize.cz plus its sister Finmag - one of the two portals this cell is named for - returned HTTP 403 to every fetch, which reads as bot defence rather than death and must be re-attempted with a browser-grade client before any completeness claim is made.
